purpose: Transfer observed sensor data into a Science analysis task without leaking unrevealed ground truth.

fields.included_observation_ids: sensor observations included in the package
fields.included_fact_keys: optional subset of known sensor facts
fields.requested_analysis: what Science is being asked to determine

rules: The handoff references only data actually known by the ship.
Science receives sensor observations plus their confidence and provenance.
Science does not receive authoritative entity truth unless already legitimately observed.
Science may request additional sensor work instead of producing a conclusion.
Completed Science findings are appended to the same persistent contact dossier with source_system=science.
The original Sensor observations remain preserved and are not replaced by Science interpretation.
